# Legacy SNPGenie selection-analysis scripts

Archived helper scripts for the pre-Nextflow SNPGenie stage of this project. They are kept
for provenance only; the maintained implementation lives in
`subworkflows/local/selection.nf` plus the `bin/` scripts it calls.

No study data is included in this repository. These scripts are documented against the
**synthetic fixtures** under `tests/data/`, which are generated by
`tests/data/generate_fixtures.sh` and contain invented sequences and invented sample
labels (`sampleA`, `sampleB`). Any real sequencing datasets this code was originally run
against are unpublished and are not distributed here.

## Inputs (synthetic fixtures)

- Reference FASTA: `tests/data/viral_ref.test.fasta`
- Annotation GFF3: `tests/data/viral_ref.test.gff3`
- SNPGenie-compatible GTF: `tests/data/viral_ref.test.gtf`
- Variant source: per-sample VCFs, e.g. `tests/data/sampleA.test.vcf`

`prepare_inputs.sh` converts a GFF3 into the GTF flavour SNPGenie expects and stages it
under `input/reference/`.

## Folder layout produced by these scripts

- `repo/`: cloned SNPGenie source (upstream, GPLv3 — see `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`)
- `scripts/`: helper scripts for prep, run, and summary
- `input/`: staged FASTA/GFF3/GTF and per-sample VCFs
- `runs/`: temporary per-sample working directories
- `output/`: SNPGenie outputs by threshold and sample
- `logs/`: per-sample SNPGenie logs and run status TSVs
- `summary/`: merged tables across samples
- `analysis/delta_selection/`: downstream delta/Kruskal and limma statistics
- `analysis/summary/`: compact downstream reporting tables

## Run

From the workspace root that contains the staged `SNPGenie/` tree:

```bash
bash SNPGenie/scripts/prepare_inputs.sh
bash SNPGenie/scripts/run_snpgenie_batch.sh
python3 SNPGenie/scripts/summarize_snpgenie_outputs.py
python3 SNPGenie/scripts/analyze_delta_selection.py
Rscript SNPGenie/scripts/analyze_delta_limma.R
python3 SNPGenie/scripts/build_compact_selection_tables.py \
  --base SNPGenie/analysis/delta_selection/detailed \
  --report-dir SNPGenie/analysis/summary \
  --product-summary SNPGenie/summary/product_results_all_samples.tsv \
  --threshold minfreq_0p01
```

`build_compact_selection_tables.py` can be pointed at any report folder and threshold:

```bash
python3 SNPGenie/scripts/build_compact_selection_tables.py \
  --base SNPGenie/analysis/delta_selection/detailed \
  --report-dir SNPGenie/analysis/summary \
  --product-summary SNPGenie/summary/product_results_all_samples.tsv \
  --threshold minfreq_0p001
```

Statistics dependency, if missing:

```bash
pip install scipy
```

## Thresholds implemented

- `minfreq_0p001` (0.1%)
- `minfreq_0p01` (1%)

## Notes

- Uses `--vcfformat=2` for LoFreq pooled-depth VCFs (`INFO` carries `DP` and `AF`).
- A sample VCF can legitimately be sparse or empty at high stringency; the batch script
  still stages it and logs success/failure explicitly rather than failing the whole run.
- SNPGenie is run in within-pool mode (`snpgenie.pl`), once per sample.
- `analyze_delta_selection.py` outputs:
  - `analysis/delta_selection/delta_per_sample.tsv` (piN, piS, Δ by sample/gene)
  - `analysis/delta_selection/delta_kruskal_by_gene.tsv` (Kruskal–Wallis by gene across
    the grouping variable + BH-FDR)
  - `--write-detailed` also emits per-threshold files
- `analyze_delta_limma.R` fits an empirical-Bayes model for `Δ ~ group` and outputs:
  - overall moderated F-test by gene
  - planned contrasts between group levels with moderated t statistics
  - BH-FDR adjusted p-values across genes
  - `--write-detailed` also emits per-threshold/per-contrast files
- `build_compact_selection_tables.py` writes:
  - `analysis/summary/selection_gene_summary.tsv`
  - `analysis/summary/selection_gene_contrasts.tsv`
  - `analysis/summary/selection_gene_key_table.tsv` — one row per gene, with mean `piN`,
    `piS`, `Δ = piN - piS` per group, limma BH-FDR, and a direction label from the sign of
    mean Δ
  - `analysis/summary/methods_key_parameters.tsv` — threshold, sample counts, and
    model/FDR settings for a methods section

Detailed and intermediate outputs land in `analysis/delta_selection/detailed/`.
